S_G_E_ADAPTATION.title: Adaptation
S_G_E_ADAPTATION.description: After this card is played, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP, convert 1 stack of a debuff into [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold]. If you have no debuffs, you still lose HP and gain [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_E_ADAPTATION.extraCardText: Lose 1 HP, remove 1 debuff stack, and gain 1 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
S_G_E_DEVOLUTION.title: Devolution
S_G_E_DEVOLUTION.description: Can only enchant Attack cards. Costs [blue]1[/blue] less. Attack damage is halved.
